// Exact method from 6756578a9d36f8bfb27f00b1fb26c6f71ac75112, used only as a failing control.
    void updateMore() {
        if ("重新加载".equals(String.valueOf(more.getText())) && state != null && !state.ready) {
            return;
        }
        if (!more.hasFocus()) {
            more.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }
